name: Szentes (Hungary)
description: Pale blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Szentes (a crowned red shield with a white tree and a fish, with red and blue mantling) above the words SZENTES VÁROS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentes arms with crown and mantling
